interpretation.exploratory: Repeatedly inspected development cohort; no confirmatory, significance, unseen-test, precision/F1, human-gold or semantic-quality claim.
interpretation.fit: Both expanded LoRA development CE decreased2048→4096; finaltrain CE is lower but considerably closer to dev than historical smaller-cohort finals. This is consistent with reduced observed source-objective overfitting, not proof of a causal data-size effect or semantic relevance.
interpretation.historical: Both expanded-cohort LoRA seeds improved genre/topic group and label recallat3 over their historical smaller-cohort finals. Head-only changes, both seeds, all signs and lexical changes are retained. This is descriptive: unique data exposure/repetition changed jointly and no contemporary small-cohort controls were run.
interpretation.new_lexical: Expanded LoRA two-seed group-macro means exceed refitted centroid lexical genre/topic; label-macro means are slightly below refitted lexical. Seed17/29 per-label macro crossings are retained, so no all-metric lexical superiority claim.
interpretation.next_decision: Keep lexical controls and inspect label/support/objective limits under a new fixed protocol. No automatic extra epochs, PPO or neural website promotion; human semantic field labels remain empty.

metric_storage: Every endpoint/facet aggregate and final training metric retained inline; full per-label metrics/log probabilities and tensor hashes remain in hash-addressed raw report/ranking/artifact references and endpoint receipts. Selected identity lists remain in referenced examples/schedules.

primary_outcomes.aggregation: Both seeds and each paired difference retained; two-seed means descriptive only.

secondary_outcomes.additional: Form/audience recallat3 and endpoints0/1024/2048 plus finaltrain diagnostic are descriptive. Paired historical4096final differences remain explicitly historical/descriptive only.

semantics.comparison: Matched lexical control decodes exact truncated formatted neural input. Prior full literal title/newline/description TF-IDF is an external reference, not an input-matched comparison.
semantics.loss: Uniform known-positive distribution per facet; mean eligible facets within each row, then mean eligible rows. Whole-empty rows excluded only from loss. Softmax pressures unassigned labels and co-positives compete; omissions remain semantically unknown.
semantics.metrics: Observed publisher-source assignment recovery only, not semantic negatives, human gold, precision, F1 or accuracy.
semantics.selection: Endpoint4096 primary; all other declared endpoints diagnostic; all seeds/arms retained, no best checkpoint selection.

source_provenance.claim: Observed authored source-label retrieval on a bounded development subset only
source_provenance.selection: SHA256(policy:role:record_id), then record_id; no label stratification or resampling
